cohort: Women (N = 1,711) with histories of cesarean and subsequent births within 5 years of participating in an online questionnaire
finding: Rural residents faced challenges in accessing VBAC, including longer travel times and fewer obstetricians and doulas, and rural women of color experienced less respectful maternity care than White, non-Hispanic rural women and all metropolitan women.
mod_finding: Rural residents faced challenges in accessing VBAC.
